Peptides are `short chains of amino acids that act as building blocks for vital skin proteins like collagen and elastin` . When applied topically, they signal the skin to repair itself, boost firmness, and reduce the look of fine lines.[[1]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/peptides-for-skin)[[2]](https://www.uchicagomedicineadventhealth.org/blog/what-are-peptides-skin-care)

### Main Types of Peptides

- **Signal Peptides:** Tell the skin to produce more collagen and elastin (e.g., Matrixyl, Palmitoyl Pentapeptide-4).
- **Carrier Peptides:** Deliver trace minerals like copper to help with skin healing and antioxidant support (e.g., Copper Tripeptides / GHK-Cu).
- **Neurotransmitter Peptides:** Relax facial micro-contractions to soften expression lines (e.g., Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 / Argireline).
- **Enzyme-Inhibitor Peptides:** Block enzymes that break down natural collagen to preserve firmness.[[1]](https://www.uchicagomedicineadventhealth.org/blog/what-are-peptides-skin-care)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CjAoaPHh5M8&t=144)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6prOQDBqtes&vl=en-US&t=93)[[4]](https://theordinary.com/en-us/blog/peptides-skincare-essential-guide.html)

### Key Benefits

- Improves skin **firmness** and **elasticity** 
- Softens the appearance of **fine lines and wrinkles** 
- Supports deep **hydration** and strengthens the **skin barrier** 
- Rare to cause irritation, making them safe for daily use on most skin types[[1]](https://www.uchicagomedicineadventhealth.org/blog/what-are-peptides-skin-care)

- **Targeted Hydration:** [Medik8 Liquid Peptides Hydrating Serum Go to product viewer dialog for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,imageDocid:13011054225406928732,gpcid:7947548051328363655,headlineOfferDocid:3981732770264226968,catalogid:12668980184755792299,productDocid:13575537056367890469,rds:PC_7947548051328363655%7CPROD_PC_7947548051328363655&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjt4Y2xh6qXAxVURZ8JHQOEF8YQxa4PegoIAggACAEIHBAd) (~$68)[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:3272057430321487294,catalogid:10973463051519897757,gpcid:6230314104366251300&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:1599641946015285056,catalogid:16152347845522780759,gpcid:42175154390984629,mid:576462746445076156&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:13575537056367890469,catalogid:12668980184755792299,gpcid:7947548051328363655&ibp=oshop)

### How to Layer Peptides

- Apply peptide serums to clean skin *before* heavy moisturizers or oils.
- **Avoid** mixing copper peptides directly with high-strength direct acids or pure Vitamin C in the exact same step, as low pH can destabilize them.[[1]](https://theordinary.com/en-us/blog/peptides-skincare-essential-guide.html)
